description: Inventory application that tracks stock across warehouses and alerts operators before products run out.

FR-1: Product tracking across warehouses requires a database to store product details and stock levels.
FR-2: Stock adjustments must be atomic to prevent partial adjustments in case of errors.
FR-3: Duplicate events must be handled to avoid redundant stock adjustments.
FR-4: Operators must receive alerts when stock levels fall below predefined thresholds.
FR-5: Negative stock levels are not allowed to prevent inventory overages.

COMP-1: Database component to store product and stock data. Linked to FR-1.
COMP-2: API Gateway for validating requests and rate-limiting. Linked to NFR-1.
COMP-3: Event Handler for processing stock adjustments and duplicate event detection. Linked to FR-3.
